senses.gloss: m. (Parthicus, Πάρθικος) scarlet-colored (sub. pellis, δέρμα) leather, scarlet-dyed dress.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:4">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> top <he>אלבישוני ב׳ וכ׳</he> dress me in scarlet (which is) neither white nor dark; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:4">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top <he>ביריריקא</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96:5">Gen. R. s. 96</cite> <he>צבועים דבריקא</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96:5">ib.</cite> s. 100 <he>מאנין דבריקה</he>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 924">Yalk. Job 924</cite> <cite ref="B00391"><he>בורקיא</he></cite> (for which <cite ref="Shabbat 114a">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>בגדי האולרין</he>). Cmp. <cite ref="A00684"><he>אוֹלָרִין</he></cite> a. <cite ref="H00806"><he>חִימּוּצָתָא</he></cite>.
